# v1.2.0 — vertical presets, and the catalog resynced to a 122-tool live set

The full server is unchanged: with no flags it exposes the same twelve featured tools
plus `search-gov-data-tools`, `describe-gov-data-tool` and `run-gov-data-tool`, and a
test pins that surface byte-for-byte against the pre-preset build.

## New: `--preset <name>` / `GOV_DATA_MCP_PRESET`

Three scoped front doors over the same package, for agents that serve one kind of buyer.
A preset narrows the **whole** surface — the named tools *and* what search / describe /
run can reach — and announces itself to the client under its own server name and
description.

| Preset | Server name | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| `phase1-esa` | `gov-data-mcp-phase1-esa` | Phase I ESA / environmental due diligence: Superfund–RCRA–UST records at ASTM E1527-21 distances, state tank & spill registries, historic land use, USGS historical topos, RCRA corrective action, orphaned wells, NWI wetlands, CWA §404, FEMA NRI, NFIP loss history, and the twenty-layer site verdict |
| `cre-leads` | `gov-data-mcp-cre-leads` | Lead feeds that answer "who just changed state": liquor licenses, SOS + tax new-business openings, WARN notices, new realtors, childcare providers, parcel owners, absentee owners, distressed-property signals, ACRIS deeds, NYC landlords, city business licenses, license verification |
| `compliance` | `gov-data-mcp-compliance` | KYB and sanctions screening: company existence, Consolidated Screening List delta, UFLPA Entity List, Medicaid/OIG exclusions, license verification, GLEIF ownership, FDIC/NCUA health, FDIC structure changes, RIA registrations, PCAOB engagements, Reg CF / Reg A+ lifecycles |

```json
{ "mcpServers": { "gov-data-phase1-esa": {
  "command": "npx", "args": ["-y", "gov-data-mcp", "--preset", "phase1-esa"],
  "env": { "APIFY_TOKEN": "apify_api_..." } } } }
```

Behaviour worth knowing:

- Every preset stays under fifteen tools, because agents choose badly past about twenty.
- A miss under a preset says so: *"This server is scoped to the `phase1-esa` preset
  (N of M catalog tools); start gov-data-mcp without --preset for the full catalog."*
  A tool that exists in the catalog but not the preset is never silently run.
- A routing note that would send the agent to a tool outside the preset is dropped rather
  than shown as a dead end.
- An unknown preset name, or `--preset` with no value, exits 2 **before** the transport
  opens. It never guesses. `npx gov-data-mcp --list-presets` prints the list as JSON.
- One npm package, one MCP registry entry, one catalog, one release train. Three separate
  packages were rejected: a first publish cannot be automated, and three catalogs drift.

## Catalog resynced to live

Two new published Actors are now visible to agents — `ucc-lapse-refinance-window` and
`ca-data-broker-registry-delta` — plus these schema changes:

- `liquor-license-new-openings-tracker`: `feed` gained `closing`; new `verifyOpenings` input.
- `sos-registry-monitor`: `mode` gained `openings`; Texas added; new `maxResults` input; title
  now "Verified New Business Openings by State & County (SOS + Tax)".
- `license-verifier`: new `mode` (with `roster-delta`), `professions`, `sinceDays` inputs.
- Eight Actors moved a category to BUSINESS (acris, childcare, city-business-license, kyb,
  liquor, parcel-owner-lookup, sos-registry, warn).

**Zero price changes.** `kyb-company-verifier` has a price change *scheduled* for
2026-10-10; the catalog quotes its active $3 per 1,000, because `pricingInfos` is a
history and the active entry is the latest whose `startedAt` has passed.

## Gates

`npm test` 84 · `node tools/mutate.cjs` 40/40 caught (17 new for presets) · live stdio
handshake per preset (server name, tool count, scope note, exit codes) · `check:catalog`
"Catalog matches live" at 122/122 including enums and price · README preset section
generated from `src/presets.js` and asserted against it.
